footer.disclaimer: FormulaLens AI is an evidence-backed cosmetic intelligence application. Ingredient evaluations are synthesized from CIR (Cosmetic Ingredient Review), European Commission CosIng, and PubMed dermatological literature. This application is for consumer research and formulation science analysis; it does not diagnose or provide medical treatments.

settings.privacy_notice: FormulaLens AI stores all data locally in your browser (IndexedDB and localStorage). No personal data is sent to our servers. When you run an analysis, the selected AI provider receives your ingredient list and retrieved evidence to generate insights. The provider's data handling policies apply.
settings.api_key_security: API keys are stored in localStorage. They may be accessible to JavaScript running in the same browser origin. Do not use this application in untrusted browser environments.
